lyrics.ja: 昨日から止まったような時計
lyrics.romaji: Kinou kara Tomatta You na Tokei
lyrics.en: A clock that seems to have stopped since yesterday
lyrics.zh: 彷彿從昨天就停止的時鐘

lyrics.ja: 幼い頃をふと思い出した
lyrics.zh: 忽然想起了小時候

lyrics.ja: 「もう心配しなくてもいいよ」
lyrics.zh: 「已經不用再擔心了喔」

lyrics.ja: あの優しい声がそばにあったから
lyrics.romaji: Ano Yasashii Koe ga Soba ni Atta kara
lyrics.en: Because that gentle voice was by my side
lyrics.zh: 因為那溫柔的聲音曾陪在身旁

lyrics.ja: 恋に傷ついて
lyrics.zh: 因戀愛而受傷

lyrics.ja: 道に迷った日もあったけれど
lyrics.romaji: Michi ni Mayotta Hi mo Atta keredo
lyrics.en: There were days I lost my way
lyrics.zh: 也曾有迷失方向的日子

lyrics.ja: いつだって探してたのは
lyrics.en: What I was always searching for
lyrics.zh: 一直以來尋找的

lyrics.ja: 輝けるはずの better day
lyrics.en: Was a better day that should shine
lyrics.zh: 是理應閃耀的 better day

lyrics.ja: Everyday 解き放て
lyrics.zh: Everyday 解放吧

lyrics.ja: ためらいがちなその emotion
lyrics.zh: 那猶豫不決的情感

lyrics.ja: 時代のせいにしたってつまらないよ
lyrics.romaji: Jidai no Sei ni Shitatte Tsumaranai yo
lyrics.zh: 歸咎於時代也太無趣了

lyrics.ja: Everyday 君であれ
lyrics.zh: Everyday 做你自己

lyrics.ja: 立ち止まる日もあるけれど
lyrics.en: There are days you stop still
lyrics.zh: 雖然也有停下腳步的日子

lyrics.ja: ねえきっと 君は大丈夫
lyrics.zh: 吶，你一定沒問題的

lyrics.ja: Step and go, step and go
lyrics.romaji: Step and Go, Step and Go
lyrics.en: Step and go, step and go
lyrics.zh: Step and go, step and go

lyrics.ja: 誰もが記憶の中にある
lyrics.romaji: Dare mo ga Kioku no Naka ni Aru
lyrics.zh: 每個人記憶中都存在著

lyrics.ja: 大事なあの笑顔 抱きしめてる
lyrics.zh: 緊抱著那重要的笑容

lyrics.ja: いつか君にまた会えたなら
lyrics.romaji: Itsuka Kimi ni Mata Aeta Nara
lyrics.en: If I can meet you again someday
lyrics.zh: 如果有一天能再見到你

lyrics.ja: 素直にちゃんと 気持ち伝えたい
lyrics.en: I want to honestly convey my feelings
lyrics.zh: 想坦率地好好傳達心意

lyrics.ja: 自分自身で引いた
lyrics.en: If it's a borderline you drew yourself
lyrics.zh: 如果是自己畫下的

lyrics.ja: ボーダーラインならさあ飛び越えて
lyrics.en: Then go ahead and leap over it
lyrics.zh: 那條界線，就跨越過去吧

lyrics.ja: いつだって描いていこうよ
lyrics.zh: 無論何時都描繪下去吧

lyrics.ja: 君らしい色で better day
lyrics.romaji: Kimi Rashii Iro de Better Day
lyrics.en: A better day in your own colors
lyrics.zh: 用屬於你的色彩描繪 better day

lyrics.ja: Everyday きらめいて
lyrics.zh: Everyday 閃耀吧

lyrics.ja: 今動き出した emotion
lyrics.en: The emotion that has started moving now
lyrics.zh: 此刻開始悸動的情感

lyrics.ja: 誰かのせいにしたってつまらないよ
lyrics.romaji: Dareka no Sei ni Shitatte Tsumaranai yo
lyrics.zh: 歸咎於他人也太無趣了

lyrics.ja: Everyday らしくあれ
lyrics.zh: Everyday 活出自我

lyrics.ja: やがてこの雨も上がって
lyrics.en: Eventually this rain will stop too
lyrics.zh: 這場雨終究會停

lyrics.ja: ねえきっと　君は大丈夫
lyrics.zh: 吶，你一定沒問題的

lyrics.ja: Step and go
lyrics.zh: Step and go

lyrics.ja: Wow, wow 挑んだ数だけ
lyrics.en: Wow, wow, as many times as you've challenged
lyrics.zh: Wow, wow 挑戰過多少次

lyrics.ja: Wow, wow 涙は出るけど
lyrics.romaji: Wow, Wow Namida ha Deru kedo
lyrics.zh: Wow, wow 就會流多少淚

lyrics.ja: Wow, 止まない雨はないように
lyrics.romaji: Wow, Yamanai Ame ha Nai You ni
lyrics.en: Wow, just as there's no rain that never stops
lyrics.zh: Wow，就像沒有下不停的雨

lyrics.ja: 君ならできるよ step and go
lyrics.romaji: Kimi Nara Dekiru yo Step and Go
lyrics.en: If it's you, you can do it—step and go
lyrics.zh: 如果是你，一定做得到 step and go
